definitions.gloss: to become accustomed to living; to get used to living in a place
definitions.explanation: to become comfortable with one's living environment through experience

examples.japanese: {住|す}み{慣|な}れた⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れたくない→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to leave the town I've grown used to living in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{住|す}み{慣|な}れた。
examples.english: I got used to living in the new place in half a year.

examples.japanese: {住|す}み{慣|な}れた⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧。
examples.english: It's sad to leave the apartment I've become comfortable living in.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live) + ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧ (to become accustomed)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れた⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ - a place one is used to living
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れた⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ - a town one is comfortable in
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れた⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ - a home one is accustomed to

COMMON PATTERNS:
~⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧ compound verbs (become used to ~):
- ⟦{聞|き}き{慣|な}れる→聞き慣れる：17602_kikinareru⟧ - become used to hearing
- ⟦{食|た}べ{慣|な}れる→食べ慣れる：08505_tabenareru⟧ - become used to eating
- ⟦{見慣|みな}れる→見慣れる：07953_minareru⟧ - become used to seeing
- ⟦{使|つか}い{慣|な}れる→使い慣れる：07877_tsukainareru⟧ - become used to using
